name: Electronic Interiors
old_description: Thank you and your team for such a great experience. Your ability to change the appointment to accommodate me and Comcast was a great example of exceptional customer service.
about:
Electronic Interiors operates from its headquarters in Lewes, Delaware, with satellite offices in Ocean City, Gaithersburg, and Wilmington. The company runs an Experience Center at its main location where clients can tour smart-home demonstrations.

The firm specializes in residential and light-commercial technology integration, including home theater installation, whole-house audio, network and alarm systems, motorized shading, smart lighting, and thermostat control. Technicians handle TV wall mounting, sound-system calibration, and router upgrades, configuring voice- and smartphone-based control platforms.

Customers are primarily homeowners in coastal Delaware and Maryland, as well as workplace clients seeking automation. Testimonials reference installations in Lewes, Rehoboth Beach, and surrounding areas for families and individuals.

The company emphasizes responsive service and clean, on-time installations, as reflected in client feedback praising technicians by name for professionalism and neatness.
built_on: Technicians noted for neatness and timeliness
